title: Input actions created in BeginPlay but bound in SetupInputComponent, which runs earlier — binds null actions
detail: UE calls SetupInputComponent during controller initialization, before BeginPlay. DrawStartAction/DrawEndAction are null when BindAction runs, so mouse draw never binds (or ensures) in PIE.
recommended_fix: Create the UInputActions in the constructor (or in SetupInputComponent before binding); keep only AddMappingContext in BeginPlay.

title: Comment claims NativeTick re-fits the camera; NativeTick never recomputes FitScale/FitOffset
detail: FitScale/FitOffset are computed only in RebuildWorld with the 1280x720 fallback. NativeTick contains no re-fit code, so any viewport other than the design size renders mis-scaled forever.
recommended_fix: Recompute FitScale/FitOffset in NativeTick (or on geometry change) from MyGeometry.GetLocalSize(); drop the false comment.

title: Camera-fit mapping duplicated between command bus and view with different size sources — diverges under DPI
detail: Input maps screen→grid from GetViewportSize pixels; rendering maps grid→screen from widget geometry (DPI-scaled Slate units, plus a 1280x720 fallback). Under DPI≠1 or fallback they disagree; drags land on wrong tiles.
recommended_fix: Single-source the fit: one function computing scale/offset from one size source, used by both ScreenToGrid and GridToScreenV.

title: bHasPrev cleared on topology change and never restored — snapshot interpolation permanently disabled after first draw
detail: After the first drawn pipe, ClearWorld sets bHasPrev=false and nothing in the NativeTick path sets it true again (only RebuildWorld does); FromGrid then always uses CurSnapshot, so the promised prev/cur eased interpolation stops working.
recommended_fix: Set bHasPrev = true after the topology rebuild in NativeTick — PrevSnapshot/CurSnapshot remain a valid interpolation pair there.

title: Demand seeded every 10 ticks but comment and story 1.3 say every 20 ticks
detail: The loop steps T by 10 (0.5 s at 20 Hz), contradicting the 20-tick (1 s) cadence stated in the same comment. Also hardcodes a 100000-tick demand horizon as a magic number.
recommended_fix: Step by kLogicHz (20) or a named kDemandIntervalTicks constant; replace 100000 with a named bound matching the story.

title: Road borders rotated about widget origin (default pivot 0,0), not center — non-horizontal roads displace
detail: RenderTransform rotates about RenderTransformPivot, default (0,0) top-left. The slot position centers the box pre-rotation; any non-zero angle swings the road off its segment. Masked only because the fixture nodes are collinear (y=2).
recommended_fix: Call SetRenderTransformPivot(FVector2D(0.5f, 0.5f)) on both borders before SetRenderTransform.

title: U-E2 hygiene check can never see the gitignored DefaultInput.ini it explicitly names
evidence:
+# U-E2: the editor boot writes this legacy-input boilerplate (Enhanced Input
+# does not read it) — never tracked, never committed.
+Config/DefaultInput.ini
 ... 
+  dirty_before="$(git status --porcelain -- Config/ 2>/dev/null)"
 ... 
+    echo "  (DefaultEngine.ini AndroidFileServer section + untracked DefaultInput.ini must stay absent — see U-E2.)" >&2
detail: git status --porcelain omits ignored files, and this same diff adds Config/DefaultInput.ini to .gitignore — exactly the file the failure message says must stay absent. That leg of the check is dead assurance.
recommended_fix: Use git status --ignored (or test -e Config/DefaultInput.ini) so an editor-boot-written ignored file still fails loud.

title: Golden v2 schema, SCHEMA.md, compare-golden --self-test, and committed-golden re-bless all absent from this diff
evidence:
+	// (topology/forwarding/flow summaries + catalog_hash — schema single-sourced
+	// in docs/goldens/SCHEMA.md).
 ... 
+	PP::BuildProbeScenario(State, Seed); // the SAME builder every surface uses
 ... 
+  "ENGINE:Golden compare (PPProbe vs standalone vs docs/goldens/ + mismatch self-test)|scripts/compare-golden.sh && scripts/compare-golden.sh --self-test"
detail: PPProbe now emits save_version 2 with new fields and gate 7 invokes compare-golden.sh --self-test, yet this diff contains no SCHEMA.md, no compare-golden.sh change, no committed-golden update, and no PP_Scenario.h definition.
recommended_fix: Ship the schema doc, the self-test support, and the re-blessed committed golden (both surfaces) in the same change set.

title: flow_summary 'delivered' and 'score' both emit State.Score
detail: Argument order maps State.Score into both 'delivered' and 'score'. If delivered is meant as a delivery counter it must come from Flow; as written the golden pins two always-identical fields.
recommended_fix: Source 'delivered' from an actual delivery counter (e.g. State.Flow.Delivered) or drop the duplicate field.

title: LastEditError/bHasLastEditError written but never read; claimed status-line rejection feedback not implemented
detail: The rejection-reason state is stored after every DrawPipe but nothing reads it; the status line renders tick/packets/score only, so rejected drags give no feedback despite the header's claim.
recommended_fix: Render LastEditError in the status text (or expose it to the view), or delete the dead members.

title: Unused accessors and snapshot field: GetCommandBus(), GetAccumulatedSeconds(), FPacketView::bOnEdge
detail: No caller in the diff uses GetCommandBus or GetAccumulatedSeconds; bOnEdge is set in BuildSnapshot but never read by the view layer. Speculative API surface.
recommended_fix: Delete until a caller exists, or note them as deliberate extension points in the PR description.

title: Header documents shadow at 12% alpha; code uses 0.14
evidence:
+//   Shadow        black @ 12% alpha, soft blob
 ... 
+const FLinearColor kShadowTint(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f, 0.14f);	  // soft blob
detail: The palette token comment and the constant disagree (0.12 vs 0.14); the look-parity checklist scores 14%. Documentation drift inside the declared look-parity baseline.
recommended_fix: Align the header comment to 14% (or change the code to 12%) — one source of truth for the palette.

title: Topology-change detection compares element counts only — same-count changes rebuild nothing
evidence:
+		const bool bTopologyChanged =
+			Next.Nodes.Num() != CurSnapshot.Nodes.Num() || Next.Pipes.Num() != CurSnapshot.Pipes.Num();
detail: A tick that removes one pipe and adds another (equal counts) skips the static-world rebuild, leaving stale roads on screen. Only safe while slice-1 edits are draw-only.
recommended_fix: Carry Topology.Gen (or a content hash) in the snapshot and compare that instead of element counts.

title: EndDraw's 'appears THIS frame' refresh never reaches the view — change detection keys on Tick
detail: The edit does not advance SimState.Tick and the view ingests snapshots only when Tick changes, so the rebuilt Snapshot sits unread until the next 20 Hz step; PrevSnapshot is also not rotated.
recommended_fix: Have the view compare a snapshot revision (or Gen) that EndDraw bumps, or accept the one-tick delay and fix the comment.

title: PIE fixture hand-rolls the scenario with magic positions despite claiming PP_Scenario.h single-sourcing
evidence:
+	PP::SpawnNode(SimState.Topology, PP::FNodeKind::Terminal, 2, 2);  // SCENARIO_SOURCE
+	PP::SpawnNode(SimState.Topology, PP::FNodeKind::Junction, 6, 2);  // SCENARIO_ROUTER
+	PP::SpawnNode(SimState.Topology, PP::FNodeKind::Terminal, 10, 2); // SCENARIO_SINK
 ... 
+// golden scenario's (1 source terminal, 1 router junction, 1 sink terminal —
+// PP_Scenario.h constants) so PIE shows the SAME topology the golden pins;
detail: The header claims the fixture uses PP_Scenario.h constants; the code inlines 2/6/10 literals as trailing comments — a second fixture builder that can silently drift from the golden scenario.
recommended_fix: Call the shared scenario builder (or real position constants) instead of duplicated literals.

title: New packet dots initialize smoothing position to (0,0) — every spawn flies in from the top-left
detail: First frame after creation: Smooth = lerp(ZeroVector, Target, 0.5), so each new dot visibly teleports halfway toward screen origin before converging over several frames — on every packet spawn.
recommended_fix: Seed PacketPrevPos with the dot's current target position (PacketPosIn of the current snapshot) on creation.
